title: Legal requirements, trust issues and engineering challenges - a multi-disciplinary case for user-specific explainability
core_idea: Examine how legal requirements, stakeholder positions and research on trust from cognitive neuroscience should inform design of user-specific explainability for domestic technologies, using AI-powered domestic robots and health wearables as case studies and considering context, stakeholder needs and duration of use.
tldr: Explores interdisciplinary factors (legal, trust, engineering, stakeholder context) that should guide tailored, user-specific explainability for AI in domestic technologies.
